# Margevia

Margevia is a product concept for supplier invoice reconciliation, designed for purchasing, operations and finance teams at restaurant groups and caterers.

## This website
- English landing page with an interactive dashboard using three fictional invoices.
- Compare agreed prices, billed prices and delivered quantities.
- Mark differences for follow-up and export sample comparisons as CSV.
- Choose a pilot team, review focus and location range locally. Pilot briefs are sent through the configured delivery flow to support@margevia.solutions.
- The Demo video tab plays a supplied 15-second motion film illustrating the fictional sample workflow; it is not a live processing demonstration.

## Product status
This is a frontend product preview. Live document processing, OCR, supplier contact, accounting integrations and recovered savings are not implemented or claimed. Data is fictional.

## Source
https://github.com/Oussamanakhil/margevia

## Journal
Six English articles at https://margevia.solutions/blog/ cover invoice checks, units and pack sizes, delivery differences, credit follow-up, the product rationale and the first preview. Four practical guides and two building stories. Examples are fictional.
